# ”Nästan alla har fått stryk trots starka orderingångar”

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-10-27  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon's morning show covers Anthropic's newly filed IPO prospectus, which gave AI stocks in Asia a lift. The hosts are sceptical that the listing is good for other AI stocks, since it will pull in a lot of capital, and they warn that big tech IPOs have often fallen 40-50% in their first year. On Q3 reports, they note that most OMXS30 engineering companies fell on report day despite strong order intake, because the market expects growth to level off. Alfa Laval and Wärtsilä beat on orders, Yubico jumped about 20% on cybersecurity hype, Tieto cut its organic growth guidance, and Sats posted a strong report.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 ELUX-B — Electrolux | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

DNB Carnegie upgraded Electrolux to buy after a report the hosts called a step forward; high debt remains a concern.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst view (DNB Carnegie), not the hosts' own call. Hosts agree the report was a step forward but stress that high debt limits how much investors dare to buy. Whirlpool's weak report and slow-recovery comments are a sector headwind, though Electrolux reported first.

#### Sell Triggers

- if leverage doesn't improve
- if appliance demand recovery stalls as Whirlpool signals

> *"här på hemmafronten har Electrolux köpstämplats idag av DNB Carnegie"*

---

### 🟠 YUBICO — Yubico | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Up ~20% on cybersecurity hype from US Twitter traders; 5x in about six months. Hosts curious whether the rise continues.

#### Reasoning

AI-driven hacking has put cybersecurity back in focus, and Yubico's physical hardware key is harder to attack with AI. But the move is driven by social media, and the hosts compare it to earlier pumps in Sivers, CDON and Fingerprint, which signals momentum and speculation risk rather than conviction.

#### Sell Triggers

- if retail/social-media momentum fades
- if valuation detaches further from earnings

> *"Det verkar vara amerikanska twittrare som har hittat till den här aktien."*

---

### 🟠 ALFA — Alfa Laval | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Orders ~14% above estimates, but 65% of OMXS30 companies have fallen on their reports despite strong orders. Guides weaker Q4 demand.

#### Reasoning

Order intake was very strong, helped by data centers and marine. However, the market is discounting a coming plateau in engineering-sector growth, and the company guides softer Q4 demand. Hosts doubt the stock will be rewarded on the day.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Q4 demand weakens as guided
- if engineering cycle plateaus

> *"Så det är inte säkert på något sätt att Alfa och Rolfa betalt för den här fina orderingången idag."*

---

### 🟠 SATS — Sats | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

EBIT +35% on 7% constant-currency growth; fewer gyms and more members. Host is only 'medium fond' of the company.

#### Reasoning

Strong margin expansion from a trend of closing gyms while adding members, which the hosts call a good recipe for profit growth. The host's enthusiasm is only moderate, and they flag the stock as one to keep an eye on rather than buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if member growth reverses
- if margin expansion stalls

> *"Och det är ju ett ganska bra recept för att öka vinsten."*

---

### ⛔ TIETOS — Tieto | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Cut full-year organic growth guidance; Q3 organic growth -11%.

#### Reasoning

Hosts called the press release very gloomy. A falling top line and lower guidance point to continued weakness in IT services.

> *"Tieto släppte ett mycket deppigt pressmeddelande igår kväll där man sänker helårsprognosen för sin organiska tillväxt."*
